place.name: Cathedral Basilica of Mérida, Venezuela
place.description: The Cathedral Basilica of the Immaculate Conception (Spanish: Catedral Basílica Menor de la Inmaculada Concepción de Mérida) or Metropolitan Cathedral of Mérida is a religious building of the Roman Catholic church located in the city of Mérida in western Venezuela, in the state of the same name, part of the Andean region in that country. It is the seat of the Archdiocese of Mérida.
